'''Adamar Kirb''' was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] who became a famous [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] and established his [[Adamar Kirb's cartel|own cartel]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Kirb's cartel eventually broke apart into many smaller gangs, but his influence was still felt by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Chevin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adamar Kirb was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Chevin [[Species/Legends|species]] in the beta release of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. However, the entry, along with many of the entries that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], were removed from the game before the game's final release in [[2011]]. However, the entry was later added into the game with Game Update 2.10 on [[September 9]], [[2014]].<ref name="Chevin" />
